claim.statement: The generated configuration schema at tag rust-v0.90.0 enumerates read-only, workspace-write and danger-full-access sandbox modes; its workspace-write object includes writable_roots and a network_access boolean whose documented default is false.

limitations: The schema records configuration shape, not observed operating-system enforcement or sandbox strength.
The three sandbox modes and network flag alternatives are configuration-scoped and must remain separate.
unknowns: The effective sandbox mode, writable roots and network flag of any session are unknown.
Platform-specific enforcement, symlink behavior, process inheritance, temporary-directory access, bypass resistance and failure behavior were not tested.

relationships.note: The exact tagged schema and rolling current security documentation discuss overlapping controls under different version applicability; neither is projected into the other's time scope.
